allow: PowerShell(Start-Sleep -Seconds 6; try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod "http://localhost:3000/api/stocks"; Write-Output "OK"; $r.stocks | Select-Object -First 4 | ForEach-Object { Write-Output \("{0,-6} today={1}% yest={2}% 1W={3}% 2W={4}% 1M={5}%" -f $_.symbol, \([math]::Round\($_.todayPct,2\)\), \([math]::Round\($_.yesterdayPct,2\)\), \([math]::Round\($_.oneWeekPct,2\)\), \([math]::Round\($_.twoWeekPct,2\)\), \([math]::Round\($_.oneMonthPct,1\)\)\) } } catch { Write-Output "FAILED: $_" })
